messages:
ana: Hey — quick design question about the Playground run history + schema editor. Thinking about adding a live 'structured output preview' pane that shows the function/tool return shape for the selected run. Could reduce the mental hop between schema & result.
sam: I like that. Is this for devs debugging tool outputs or for end-user docs?
ana: Mostly for debugging and making schema edits faster. Example: you edit a function def in the schema editor, flip to a past run and see a rendered JSON object with inline diffs.
matt: inline diffs sounds heavy in the UI. Maybe start with a collapsible preview under each run entry? Keep run list density high.
julie: +1 to collapsible. Also we need to avoid duplicating the big payloads by default for perf — lazy load the preview.
ridhi: accessibility note — if it's collapsible, ensure the toggle is keyboard focusable and has aria-expanded, and the preview container uses aria-live="polite" so screen readers notice changes.
ana: good call. Also thinking about a small toolbar in the preview for: copy JSON, open in schema editor, and copy as TypeScript type.
sam: copy & open-in-editor are must-haves. For copy-as-TS, maybe an experimental option behind a kebab menu.
matt: UX nit on labels: avoid 'schema' vs 'definition' ambiguity. In the preview toolbar use 'Open in function editor' and 'Export sample response' instead.
julie: accessibility nits: ensure copied content is announced with a toast and that toast is accessible (role=alert). Keyboard shortcuts for copy would be nice (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C?).
ridhi: on focus management after toggling preview open — move focus to the preview header but make it easy to escape back to the run entry with Escape. Screen readers should not get trapped.
playground-bot: Deploy preview build available at https://playground-staging.redwood.ai/ — branch: feature/run-preview — contains initial preview component (lazy) :rocket:
ana: re: run history density, propose 3 states: collapsed (no preview), inline preview (small, single-line summary), full preview (expanded JSON with actions). Default collapsed.
matt: acceptance criteria idea: 1) preview loads lazily; 2) actions present & accessible; 3) preview diff highlights changed keys; 4) perf impact measured on large traces (>=50KB payload).
sam: copy text tweak: change 'Open in editor' -> 'Open in schema editor (preserve cursor pos)'. Minor, but devs lose context today.
julie: design ask: can we make the inline summary show key fields using the function schema so it's not just raw JSON? e.g., render primary string fields. That helps scannability.
ridhi: aria suggestion for inline summary: role="list" with listitems for each key so SR users can jump between fields.
ana: I'll mock a couple variants (compact summary + full JSON) and post screens.
matt: can you include a keyboard-only flow in the mock? I can run quick keyboard/a11y test after.
ana: will do. Posting in the channel when ready — thanks all for quick input :heart:
playground-bot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: 3  :eyes: 2  — feedback recorded to ticket RW-UI-887.
